recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the original PA decision in the active core Patient $match OperationDefinition and aligns the operation definition with the already-updated Patient narrative. No further core source change is recommended for FHIR-12594; FHIR-40911 remains a separate FHIR-extensions issue.
issue_request: FHIR-12594 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Patient change request asking that Patient $match not require every returned patient record to include the match-grade extension, because some MPIs do not produce match grading and the search score already conveys match certainty.
initial_application: Git commit 276058c0c9 applied FHIR-12594 to source/patient/patient-notes.xml by changing the narrative from 'SHALL have a score' to 'should have a score'. The current OperationDefinition source still retained the old mandatory sentence in both the generated footer and OperationDefinition.comment, so the application was incomplete for the operation artifact.
additional_context: Patient is active in source/fhir.ini, OperationDefinition is an active metadata resource, and source/patient/list-Patient-operations.xml references OperationDefinition/Patient-match. The Patient narrative already had relaxed wording, FHIR-39400 later clarified the returned Bundle as a searchset without changing this requirement, and FHIR-40911 later noted that FHIR-12594 still needed to be re-applied in core while handling separate FHIR Extension Pack match-grade description work.
reconciliation: Changed source/patient/operationdefinition-Patient-match.xml so both the build footer valueMarkdown and OperationDefinition.comment say patient records 'should' have the score and match-grade extension instead of 'SHALL' have them. This removes the stale conformance requirement while preserving the example and extension link.
